title: Move safety: replace string-named class and package lookups (tool package scan, AutomationRuntime and AudioSystem Class.forName, MeshNodeRegistry type string, catalog category from package name)
description:
Repo plan phase 0; every package move in phase 1 is blocked on this, because these compile cleanly after a move and break at run time:
- gui/terminal/Terminal.java:67-73,157-185 fills toolMap by scanning the package string 'ixdar.gui.ui.tools' (and silently skips tools without a no-arg constructor).
- Canvas3D (~186), gui/ui/menu/MenuBox (~99), platform/input/KeyGuy (~60) and MouseTrap look up 'ixdar.platform.automation.endpoints.AutomationRuntime' by string.
- Canvas3D (~103-179) reaches audio/AudioSystem and AudioAssets by string.
- annotations/.../meshnode/MeshNodeRegistry.java:24-27 names 'ixdar.geometry.mesh.nodes.api.MeshNode' by string.
- geometry/mesh/documentation/MeshNodeCatalog.java:125-142 derives a node's category from its package's last segment, so moving nodes rewrites catalog categories (quadlayout, network and dungeon already fall to OTHER).
The reflection exists to keep desktop-only code (OpenAL, the automation server) out of the TeaVM web build; that must still hold. Replace the lookups with something a move cannot break: a class-literal registration made by the desktop launcher, a service hook on the Platform, or a compile-checked constant, whichever fits each case without a new class where an existing one can hold it. Give @MeshNodeAnnotation a category element (default derived as today) and set it on the nodes that fall to OTHER.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. No Class.forName or package-name string in main code names an ixdar class or package outside platform/gl backend selection (list any that must remain, with the reason, on the ticket).
2. The web build still excludes OpenAL and the automation server (TeaVM build passes, or the ticket shows why it cannot run here).
3. Node categories come from the annotation; the generated catalog JSON is identical to master except nodes that were OTHER now carry a real category.
4. Terminal tool switching (ct) works for every tool it worked for before.
5. Unit suite passes; launch entry and screenshot.

6. (User, 2026-10-17, option 2b) Node categories are a closed enum, not strings: a NodeCategory enum in the annotations module (next to MeshNodeAnnotation) whose constants carry the display names used today (Primitives, Modifiers, Math & Logic, Field & Data, Geometry Operations, Curve Operations, Control Flow, Closure, Patch & Surface, Selection, Transform, Quad Layout, Network, Dungeon, and any other the catalog emits). @MeshNodeAnnotation.category() is REQUIRED (no default) and typed NodeCategory; every node (all ~124) declares one; MeshNodeCatalog's package-name switch and the OTHER fallback are deleted. mesh-node-catalog.json's category values are identical to before for every node (the 23 that ENG-17 already assigned keep theirs).
testing-plan:
1. grep Class.forName and quoted 'ixdar.' strings before/after.
2. Diff mesh-node-catalog.json and automation_routes.json against master.
3. Live: ct in the TSP scene; audio plays in a scene that uses it; ixdar-cli health against a desktop scene.
changes-made: Desktop-only services reached through Platform hooks, following nativeCholeskyBackend/meshBooleanBackend: Platform.audio() returns the new AudioBackend interface (AudioSystem implements it) and Platform.automation() the new AutomationBackend interface (AutomationRuntime implements it); LwjglPlatform and HeadlessPlatform return the singletons, WebPlatform returns null. Interfaces are required: a first attempt returning the concrete classes made TeaVM link AutomationRuntime.<clinit> (4 [ERROR]s: ConcurrentLinkedQueue, Gson). Canvas3D, MenuBox, KeyGuy, MouseTrap, Scene, TradeScene, MainScene drop every Class.forName; AutomationInputBinder.bind folded into AutomationRuntime.bindInput and the class deleted; one public Canvas3D.bindAutomationIfAvailable replaces four copies. audioPlaySfx takes the AudioAssets constant, not a field name.

Terminal tools: the 'ixdar.gui.ui.tools' package scan replaced by a compile-checked List.of(FreeTool, MapEditorTool, NegativeCutMatchViewTool, NeighborViewTool), the four tools the scan instantiated (HeadquartersPicker and RoutePlanning have no no-arg constructor and were skipped before too); toolClassMap is Class<? extends Tool>.

Annotations: RegistryProcessor.getSupportedAnnotationTypes() returns the annotation class literal's name, so the five @SupportedAnnotationTypes strings are gone; MeshNodeRegistry names its supertype by simple name 'MeshNode' and the processor reads its package off the annotated classes' supertypes (generated source byte-identical). @MeshNodeAnnotation gains category() (blank = derived from package as before); set on the 23 nodes that fell to Other: 12 Quad Layout, 4 Network, 7 Dungeon. mesh-node-catalog.json diff vs master is exactly those 23 lines; automation_routes.json unchanged. Also WebMathTransformer uses WebMath.class.getName(), AutomationRouteCatalog's generatedFrom uses its class name, NodeGraphRuntime uses RegistryProcessor.DESKTOP_SUFFIX.

Remaining string-named lookups (DoD 1): NodeGraphRuntime.desktopRegistryMap keeps Class.forName(MeshNodeRegistry_MeshNodes.class.getName() + RegistryProcessor.DESKTOP_SUFFIX): the name is derived from a class literal plus the processor's constant so a move cannot break it, and it must work without a Platform (ExportMeshNodeCatalog, unit tests). MeshNodeCatalog still maps package leaf names to categories as the annotation's blank default, as this ticket specified; nodes that move out of a package-named category must set category explicitly. Outside main code: pom mainClass/transformer names and launch.json mainClass entries are strings by nature.

Verification: TeaVM build OK (classes.js 7,286,224 bytes vs 7,277,112 baseline, 0 [ERROR]); no AutomationRuntime, AudioSystem, AutomationApiServer, AutomationRecorder, LwjglPlatform, HeadlessPlatform, AL10/ALC10 or Gson class in either bundle; the four tools are now in the bundle (+9 KB), as Terminal was already reachable from WebLauncher. Unit suite 518/518 (SuitePlatform now overrides automation() to null: with window 0 the newly un-swallowed GLFW setKeyCallback NPE'd, which the reflection used to hide, and unit tests should not bind an automation port). Live, scene ixdar-canvas: ixdar-cli health ok; ct fr/free/me/mapeditor/neg/negativecutmatchview/nbr/neighborview each switch (Tool: Free / Map Editor / Negative Cut / Neighbor View in tmp/eng-17-ct-*.png); recorder logs abstract key/click actions. Scene ixdar: audio INIT_OK and the menu music and click SFX reach AudioSystem with the AudioAssets paths, but the WAVs are LOAD_FAIL missing because no IxdarAssets checkout exists on this machine.

DoD 6 (closed enum): new annotations/.../meshnode/NodeCategory enum (PRIMITIVES, MODIFIERS, MATH_LOGIC, FIELD_DATA, GEOMETRY_OPERATIONS, CURVE_OPERATIONS, CONTROL_FLOW, CLOSURE, PATCH_SURFACE, SELECTION, TRANSFORM, QUAD_LAYOUT, NETWORK, DUNGEON), each carrying today's displayName. @MeshNodeAnnotation.category() is now NodeCategory with no default; all 124 annotated nodes (all in main; test has none) declare one, chosen from the package mapping or the existing string so every catalog category is unchanged. MeshNodeCatalog's package-leaf switch, categoryFromClass and the OTHER constant are deleted; the catalog reads ann.category().displayName. ARCHITECTURE.md mesh-node paragraph updated. Verified after syncing onto master: regenerated mesh-node-catalog.json byte-identical to the pre-change file; generated MeshNodeRegistry_MeshNodes and _MeshNodesDesktop byte-identical; mvn test 521/521; tools/teavm-build.sh OK (classes.js 7,283,789 bytes, 0 [ERROR]).
